Type Parameters:

All Known Implementing Classes:
Record
@Public @Evolving public interface ReadOnlyRecord<K,V>
A read-only view of a record's key, value, timestamp, and headers.

This is the shared read surface of a record: the processing-layer Record extends it with transform-and-forward builders (withKey/withValue/withTimestamp/withHeaders), while an Interactive Query (IQv2) result is exactly this read-only snapshot and exposes nothing more. It is the result type returned by the headers-aware IQv2 query types, which surface the record headers persisted by header-aware state stores.

    • headers

      Headers headers()
      The headers of the record. Never null.

      The returned Headers should be treated as read-only. Records served as IQv2 results from a state store have their headers frozen via RecordHeaders.setReadOnly(), so adding or removing a header throws IllegalStateException. Freezing is not a deep copy, however: the value() bytes of an existing header can still be mutated in place, so callers must not modify them.
